plainTranslation: Emotional security that comes easily. Quiet commitment, dependable warmth, the sense of being safely held. Failure mode: steady drifts toward flat if no one adds heat. Use the stability to commit to something lasting, and keep warmth deliberate so it doesn't go quiet.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep:
This connection can remind you that care is something you can count on. There is a quiet steadiness here, a sense that someone is paying attention even when they are not making a show of it. Their presence can be grounding. They follow through. They make room for what is real. And when life gets heavy, they are often still standing beside you. If you have known inconsistency or disappointment, that kind of reliability can feel deeply restorative.

At its best, this is emotional stability. Their presence helps you calm down instead of spiral. They remind you that feelings do not have to control your life to be valid. Over time, you may trust yourself more because someone consistently treats your emotions like they matter.

The downside is that their practicality can sometimes feel a little too practical. They may focus on solving the problem instead of sitting with the feeling. Their realism can sometimes come across as emotionally detached, even when they are trying to help. Because they tend to approach things logically, it can be easy to miss the moment when useful perspective starts feeling like your feelings are being brushed aside.

The lesson here is simple: stability is good, but feelings still need room to exist.
